dispositions.tranche_5_finding: unsupported numeric standard - "1.0-1.3 m/s: new lifeboat lowering speed range (replacing the old H-dependent formula)"
dispositions.detail: The claim is a REPLACEMENT claim - that a new range supersedes the LSA Code's height-dependent lowering-speed formula - and a replacement claim cannot be adjudicated from the number alone. The card is a consolidated 2024-2028 SOLAS/MARPOL amendment overview, so the same acquisition closes several of its rows at once. NOT corrected in Pass 1: section 7 permits correction only where held primary source directly adjudicates the claim or the proposition is internally contradicted with the correct in-repo source already established. Neither holds. Guessing a figure here would repeat the defect class this pass exists to close.
source_required: the adopting MSC resolution for the lowering-speed amendment

This card ALSO carries long-rule authoring residue, which is Pass-2 backlog.

dispositions.tranche_5_finding: IACS members - list all member societies
dispositions.detail: A membership list is a LIVE list, and its defect mode is currency rather than support: it goes wrong when a society joins, leaves or merges, with no edit to the card. Section 8.2b of the batch skill governs how to ask - the question is what IACS's own listing says MOST RECENTLY, never whether a supersession this session already suspects occurred. Registering the IACS members page with a currentness state and a revalidation trigger is what closes this durably; correcting the list once does not. This card also carries long-rule authoring residue (Pass-2 backlog).
source_required: IACS official membership listing, registered with a currentness state and revalidation trigger
